description: Per-VM customer-managed-key (CMK) disk encryption helpers for Azure: mint a Key Vault key and a Disk Encryption Set (DES) per VM, grant the DES identity key access (RBAC role or access policy), deallocate/PATCH-disks/start to apply the DES to OS+data disks, optionally enable encryption at host, and the reverse for teardown. Raw REST via requests (Key Vault / Authorization SDKs not confirmed in the appliance venv), authenticating with the Resource Handler service principal; every call cites its Microsoft REST reference. Used by OHK-vklpnqhq (Post-Provision) and OHK-2vpg4pff (Post-Delete).
label: Azure Disk Encryption (CMK)
name: azure_disk_encryption
